answer: An agent economy can mitigate Sybil attacks using slashable proof-of-stake bonds. Candidate agents lock collateral in a decentralized consensus kernel before interacting within the protocol oasis. Any detected protocol manipulation triggers automated slashing that sinks the offending bond balance to an absolute nadir, imposing a verifiable capital cost per identity. However, this economic hurdle privileges wealthy entities while penalizing resource-constrained, honest agents.
